## Standing operator rules

- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.
- Do not retry the six-hour Celery `visibility_timeout`; it hid stuck jobs for hours.
- Staging writes must use Redis `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is being drained and must not receive writes.
